text: Final categorization: **OK** (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that meets all core inclusion criteria. It implements a national-scale LULC simulation for Taiwan (35,808 sq.km), with the primary objective of predicting LULC for 2030 and 2050. It uses the SVM-Markov model to implement and quantitatively compare four distinct future scenarios (2, 3, 5, and 6-variable conditions). The study reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Overall Accuracy 0.87, Kappa 0.74 for 2020 validation) and provides mapped LULC projections. It does not meet any of the exclusion criteria.)
